text:
sara: Brought up Orion-RT-13B int4 using rw-quant/awq. Short-context looks fine.

liam: Which conversion flags?

sara: `rw-convert --model orion-rt-13b --backend awq --quant int4 --per-channel --preserve-rotary`

jordan: Ran long-context eval (4k tokens). SQuAD EM drops ~8.2 points; hallucination spikes on multi-hop QA.

mira: Paste logs + tokenizer tail, please.

sara: Logs:
```
[2026-03-19 22:10:03] kv_lookup: found id 50265 > vocab_size(50256)
[2026-03-19 22:10:03] kvcache: read_offset shifted by -9
[2026-03-19 22:10:04] load_model: rotary_freq != exported_freq (model: 1000, file: 996)
```

sara: tokenizer tail (last ids): ...50248, 50249, 50256

liam: that smells like pad/unk aliasing after vocab trimming. Converter sometimes collapses unused token slots which reindexes highest ids.

jordan: Also seeing a warning at load time: "rotary_freq != exported_freq" — might be a separate angle scaling mismatch.

mira: Hypothesis: converter trimmed the tokenizer (shrank_vocab) but didn't emit a remap. KVCACHE stores raw token ids; on load they become >vocab_size and we underflow offsets.

sara: Minimal repro attached in CI job 4721, script: `scripts/repro/longctx_orion.sh` (runs eval at 4k, dumps kv ops).

liam: Quick mitigation ideas: 1) runtime remap ids > vocab_size back to original_id using a token_remap.json; 2) converter preserves highest_id and pads holes so original ids stay stable. Option 2 safer.

sara: I pushed a temp runtime patch that remaps out-of-range ids -> nearest sentinel, but that is a hack. Opening a PR to keep original id space in the converter. PR: #3321.

mira: For the rotary mismatch: check if exporter normalized rotary base/freq. If exporter truncated headdim/perm it could change freq. Need a deterministic export -> import test.

jordan: I ran a quick experiment: loading the int4 file with fp16 weights restored yields no QA drop. So quality regression is tied to both id remap + rotary scaling differences after quant.

liam: Perf tradeoff if we keep full vocab (no collapsing): model size on disk + tokenizer table slightly larger, but avoids correctness bugs. Suggest we prefer correctness for now.

sara: Agreed. I'll update converter to emit token_remap.json and preserve max_id. Also add an integrity check in CI that compares original max_token_id -> exported.max_token_id.

mira: Also add a unit test: kvcache roundtrip where token ids == max_original_id should survive save/load.

ops-bot: deploy triggered for canary cluster eng-ml-canary-3 (user: sara) :rocket:

liam: Monitoring longctx SQuAD EM now (will report in morning).

jordan: I'll run full regression suite overnight and post numbers.

sara: thanks team :thumbsup:
